Talent0_2Ability.name: Auto Mod
Talent0_2Ability.SpecificEffects: After performing active repairs, grant <buf ID=5004502>[Regular Repair I]</buf> to the target, effective for <color=#F74848>2</color> times and lasting for <color=#F74848>2</color> turns.

Talent3_5Ability.name: Auto Mod
Talent3_5Ability.SpecificEffects:
After performing active repairs, grant <buf ID=5004502>[Regular Repair I]</buf> to the target, effective for <color=#F74848>2</color> times and lasting for <color=#F74848>2</color> turns.
When executing an individual repair skill, additionally apply <buf ID=5004512>[Magnetize Repair]</buf> to the target, effective for <color=#F74848>1</color> time and lasting for <color=#F74848>2</color> turns.

500001.name: CEC 1
500001.SpecificEffects: In cooperation with allies, launch a <buf ID=900002>[Link Attack]</buf> against the target, dealing <color=#F74848>0.2x</color> DMG, effective up to <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn.

700009.name: Wide-Range Repair
700009.describe: Restore the HP of all allies within the selected <range type=1>Diamond (2 tiles) area</range>. The repair amount is <color=#F74848>1.0x</color> the Manipulator's Repair AMT. It can repair <color=#F74848>1</color> damaged part.

500403.name: Follow-up Care
500403.SpecificEffects: When involved in a <buf ID=900002>[Link Attack]</buf>, perform <buf ID=900020>[Assist Repair]</buf> on the ally who led the attack. The repair amount is <color=#F74848>0.3x</color> the Manipulator's Repair AMT. This cannot repair damaged parts and is effective up to <color=#F74848>2</color> times per turn.

700037.name: Harmlessness
700037.SpecificEffects: After performing active repairs, dispel <color=#F74848>1</color> debuff.

500405.name: Full Auto
500405.SpecificEffects: When an ally within the adjacent (<color=#F74848>2</color> tiles) area is attacked, automatically perform <buf ID=900020>[Assist Repair]</buf> on the ally after combat. The repair amount is <color=#F74848>0.3x</color> the Manipulator's Repair AMT. This cannot repair damaged parts and is effective up to <color=#F74848>2</color> times per turn.

500406.name: Repair Empathy
500406.describe: Restore the HP of all parts of an ST. The repair amount is <color=#F74848>1.6x</color> the Manipulator's Repair AMT. This can repair <color=#F74848>1</color> damaged part. Additionally, restore the same repair amount to <color=#F74848>another</color> ally with the lowest HP, which can also repair <color=#F74848>1</color> damaged part and trigger the <buf ID=900059>[Auto Mod]</buf> effect.

500407.name: Field Maintenance
500407.SpecificEffects: After performing active repairs, apply <buf ID=7100102>[Hit Rate UP I]</buf> and <buf ID=7100304>[DMG UP II]</buf> to the target, lasting for <color=#F74848>2</color> turns.

500408.name: Full Line Maintenance
500408.describe: Restore the HP of all parts of an ST. The repair amount is <color=#F74848>1.75x</color> the Manipulator's Repair AMT. This can repair <color=#F74848>1</color> damaged part. Additionally, restore the same repair amount to <color=#F74848>2</color> allies with the lowest HP, which can also repair <color=#F74848>1</color> damaged part and trigger the <buf ID=900059>[Auto Mod]</buf> effect.

500011.name: CEC 2
500011.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=900002>[Link Attack]</buf>'s effective times per turn <color=#F74848>+1</color>.

500012.name: Part Maintenance 1
500012.SpecificEffects: After performing active repairs, dispel <color=#F74848>1</color> debuff.

500021.name: CEC 3
500021.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=900002>[Link Attack]</buf>'s damage multiplier is increased to <color=#F74848>0.3</color>.

500031.name: Emergency Repair 1
500031.SpecificEffects: At the end of the action, randomly select a single adjacent (<color=#F74848>1</color> tile) ally to perform <buf ID=900018>[Passive Repair]</buf>. The repair amount is <color=#F74848>0.6x</color> the Manipulator's Repair AMT and cannot repair damaged parts.

500033.name: Flexible Repair
500033.SpecificEffects: After performing active repairs, an additional <color=#F74848>2</color> tiles can be moved.

500034.name: Emergency Repair 2
500034.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=900018>[Passive Repair]</buf> selects targets within the adjacent (<color=#F74848>2</color> tiles) area.

500035.name: Emergency Repair 3
500035.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=900018>[Passive Repair]</buf>'s Repair AMT is now <color=#F74848>1x</color> that of the Manipulator.

500036.name: Emergency Repair 4
500036.SpecificEffects: The number of targets that <buf ID=900018>[Passive Repair]</buf> can repair increases by <color=#F74848>1</color>.

500441.name: Canary 1
500441.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=900038>[Regular Repair]</buf>'s Repair AMT is now <color=#F74848>0.45x</color> that of the Manipulator.

500043.name: Part Maintenance 3
500043.SpecificEffects: Each turn, the AP Cost of the 1st repair skill decreases by <color=#F74848>1</color>, with a minimum cost of <color=#F74848>1</color> AP.

500444.name: Canary 2
500444.SpecificEffects: The effective times for <buf ID=900038>[Regular Repair]</buf> is now <color=#F74848>+1</color>.

500445.name: Canary 3
500445.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=900038>[Regular Repair]</buf> is triggered after being attacked.

500446.name: Canary 4
500446.SpecificEffects: The Repair AMT of <buf ID=900038>[Regular Repair]</buf> is increased by <color=#F74848>200%</color> for the part with the lowest HP.
